## Checklist

- [ ] Passive only: no port scanning, brute force, authentication bypass, or login attempts
- [ ] Keyed lookups do not submit the target for active scanning
- [ ] API keys are not logged, committed, or placed in findings
- [ ] Tests cover the change and do not require live network access
- [ ] `make ci` passes (ruff, format, mypy, pytest)
- [ ] README source table and docs are updated if a source or a flag changed
- [ ] No private target data in the diff
